new_nodes.label: Concrete Crossed Body/Tool Protocol
new_nodes.statement: Fix four counterbalanced human sessions q,r in {0,1}: q contrasts logged 100 Hz wrist-tendon vibration with a matched bony-site control; r contrasts a logged 30-degree cursor/tool transform with the identity transform. After separately reinduced blocks, obtain tool-released angular body localization Y_B and tool-held no-cursor angular endpoint Y_T. Normalize both by a frozen 30-degree physical reference to [0,1]. Define conditional simple-effect magnitudes and set a=min_r d_B^B(r), x=max_q d_B^T(q), b=max_r d_T^B(r), y=min_q d_T^T(q).
new_nodes.domain: Prospective, ethics-approved healthy-adult upper-limb protocol only; no participant was recruited and no intervention was executed in R161.
new_nodes.scope: Prospective, ethics-approved healthy-adult upper-limb protocol only; no participant was recruited and no intervention was executed in R161.
new_nodes.source_lineage: R160:INTERVENTION_PROFILE_CONTRACT plus primary component methods; no source implements the complete crossed design.
new_nodes.proof: Definition; interaction-robust min/max estimands are fixed before outcome inspection.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Tendon vibration is not afferent-pure; readouts are finite; normalization is conventional; no complete organization or F_O is identified.

new_nodes.label: Six-Part Protocol Admissibility Gate
new_nodes.statement: For the R161 candidate, classification is admissible iff all six preregistered delivery, cross-invariance, washout and manipulation-sensitivity gates pass. If any gate fails, the only profile output is INVALID_PROTOCOL; failure may not be counted as a neither profile or evidence against basal experience.
new_nodes.domain: Exactly the fixed R161 protocol and six named gates; the gate does not prove selective spindle causation, complete neural realization or F_O.
new_nodes.scope: Exactly the fixed R161 protocol and six named gates; the gate does not prove selective spindle causation, complete neural realization or F_O.
new_nodes.source_lineage: R161 protocol definition and its explicit failure-state repair.
new_nodes.proof: Exhaustive Boolean split of the six gates; the exact verifier checks all 64 assignments.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Passing device and manipulation checks does not prove pathway purity or a phenomenal interpretation.

new_nodes.label: Three-Way Body-Dominance Decision
new_nodes.statement: Under the valid R161 gate and simultaneous bounds for the interaction-robust a,x estimands, fix epsilon>0. Confirm body dominance if L(a)>epsilon and L(a)-U(x)>epsilon. Strongly exclude the fixed candidate if U(a)<=epsilon or U(a)-L(x)<=epsilon. Otherwise return unresolved. Confirm and exclude are disjoint; both decisions persist under nested interval refinement. The symmetric construction applies to y,b for tool dominance.
new_nodes.domain: One fixed protocol, normalization, epsilon, error model and familywise simultaneous coverage statement; not a test of every possible body organization, C1, B_min or F_O.
new_nodes.scope: One fixed protocol, normalization, epsilon, error model and familywise simultaneous coverage statement; not a test of every possible body organization, C1, B_min or F_O.
new_nodes.source_lineage: R160:FOUR_WAY_PROFILE instantiated with R161's concrete, admissible, interaction-robust estimands.
new_nodes.proof: Interval order proves disjointness and nested-refinement stability. Exact enumeration covers 225 rational interval pairs and 4,900 nested cases.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Wide intervals remain unresolved; failed fidelity is invalid; exclusion is protocol-specific and does not refute C1 or F_O.

new_rules.statement: The concrete protocol has an exhaustive admissible/invalid status determined by all six predeclared gates; any failed gate blocks profile classification.
The fixed R160 predicate, concrete interaction-robust estimands, passed fidelity gate and simultaneous intervals jointly yield disjoint confirm/exclude/unresolved decisions.
new_rules.proof_sketch: Use interval order L<=U for disjointness and inclusion-monotonic lower/upper bounds for refinement stability.
